The owner's follow-up instruction:

now fix the other test

## Asking the owner

If you need a decision only the owner can make, write one question to <runs>/<run>.question and end your turn. The owner's answer resumes this session. Do not ask what you can decide yourself.

If code from a blocking ticket is missing from your branch, start the question with MISSING-DEPENDENCY: and name what is missing. Do not implement the blocker's work yourself.
